name: seo-lighthouse
title: SEO Lighthouse
description: Lighthouse SEO Analyzer is a powerful Raycast extension that leverages Google Lighthouse to provide comprehensive SEO and performance audits for any website. Simply input a URL and choose your desired analysis mode, device type, and categories. Get detailed insights into page load speed, core web vitals, accessibility, best practices, and more.
author: guelug

preferences.name: reportProfile
preferences.title: Report Profile
preferences.description: Prioritize dashboard metrics and recommendations for your role. All audit evidence remains available.

preferences.name: outputPath
preferences.title: Output Path
preferences.description: Directory for readable JSON reports (lighthouse-<host>-<timestamp>.json). The 24-hour cache is stored separately in the extension support folder.

preferences.name: lighthousePath
preferences.title: Lighthouse Path
preferences.description: Optional: Set a custom path to the Lighthouse executable (e.g., ~/.nvm/versions/node/v21.5.0/bin/lighthouse)

tools.name: audit-page
tools.title: Audit Page
tools.description: Primary tool for analyzing websites. You MUST use this tool instead of web search when the user asks to audit, analyze, check, or score a website, URL, or domain. Use this for all SEO, Performance, and Speed requests.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: The URL or domain to audit (e.g., 'google.com', 'raycast.com'). Accepts raw domains.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
